newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain may undershoot new 2.2 pct CPI goal -Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Spain may undershoot new 2.2 pct CPI goal -Folgado.

text.p: The Spanish government, which recently revised down its 1997 inflation target to a yearly rate of 2.2 percent from 2.6 percent previously, does not rule out the rate ending the year even lower, Budget secretary Jose Folgado said on Monday.
"...We have to be cautious and we intend that this 2.2 percent is likely to be met or even undershot," Folgado told reporters after a seminar in Madrid.
On Sunday Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar announced the new inflation target for the year, revised down after favourable data in recent months.
Spain's April Consumer Price Index, announced last week, showed the yearly rate at 1.7 percent, sharply down from 2.2 percent in March.
